name: Web Development Basics - Full Length Mock Test 43

questions.question: What will JavaScript Array.prototype.reduce() return if called on an empty array without an initial value in Full Mock 43?
questions.hint: Calling reduce on an empty array without initial value throws TypeError.

questions.question: Which CSS Flexbox property controls the alignment of flex items along the cross axis in Full Mock 43?
questions.hint: align-items defines default behavior for how flex items are laid out along the cross axis.

questions.question: In HTML5, which tag is best suited for defining an independent, self-contained piece of content in Full Mock 43?
questions.hint: <article> represents a self-contained composition in a document.

questions.question: In Node.js asynchronous I/O, which API executes callbacks on the Next Tick Queue before any microtasks in Full Mock 43?
questions.hint: process.nextTick queues callbacks to run before event loop continues.

questions.question: Which SQL clause is used to filter query results based on aggregate function values in Full Mock 43?
questions.hint: HAVING clause filters groups created by GROUP BY based on conditions.

questions.question: In React, which hook allows component state to persist across renders without causing re-renders in Full Mock 43?
questions.hint: useRef returns a mutable ref object whose .current property persists without triggering re-render.
